fullPassage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture.

(A) To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties.

(B) Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks.

(C) We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

det.korean: 규정 설명 → (B) 복도=대피 경로+위험성 → (A) 물품 제거 요청+벌칙 → (C) 협조 감사
det.analysis:
① (B) — (A) — (C): 위험 설명 → 제거 요청 → 감사 ←정답
② (A) — (B) — (C): 요청이 위험 설명 앞에 옴 부자연
③ (C) — (B) — (A): 감사가 먼저 올 수 없음
④ (B) — (C) — (A): 감사 뒤에 요청 부자연
det.tip: 위험 설명 → 조치 요청 → 마무리 감사

③ ③: 제거 요청 직후 벌칙 경고 ←정답
